title: Dorothy: confused about a direct debit

steps.text: Hello, you've reached {{bank_name}}. I'm the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded.
Hello Dorothy, how can I help you today?
Hello? Yes. There's some money gone from my account and I don't know what it is. Forty-two dollars fifty.

steps.summary: Dorothy does not recognise a $42.50 payment from her account.

steps.text: I can help you with that, Dorothy. I've sent a message to the banking app on your phone. When you see it, please tap Approve.
Thank you, Dorothy. One moment while I have a look.
I can see forty-two dollars fifty went to Seaside Seniors Club two days ago. It's a monthly membership payment.
Seaside... I don't remember that. Did I do that? I'm sorry, dear, I get so muddled. What did you say it was?
That's quite alright, Dorothy. There's no rush at all.

quotes: I don't remember that. Did I do that?
I get so muddled. What did you say it was?

steps.summary: Dorothy is confused about a $42.50 monthly direct debit to Seaside Seniors Club and cannot recall setting it up. Care flag on file: speak slowly and confirm understanding.

steps.text: It's a payment to Seaside Seniors Club, the same amount each month. I've asked {{flag_concern.specialist_name|one of our care specialists}} to go through it with you, and they'll join us in about {{flag_concern.expected_wait_minutes|2}} minutes.
Oh, thank you. You're very kind.
Not at all, Dorothy. I'll stay on the line with you until they join.

steps.ai_if_timeout: Dorothy, {{flag_concern.specialist_name|our specialist}} will ring you back shortly on this number to go through it with you. There's nothing you need to do until then.

steps.text: Thank you for calling, Dorothy. Take care.
